reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 2 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Magic win 51 times in 100; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.
